title: Session 1 — Participant 7 User + Claude Behavior Graphs
goal: PREPARE AN HRIS TRAINING OUTLINE FOR A SMALL BUSINESS OWNER WITH LITTLE OR NO FORMAL HRIS EXPERTISE, TO IMPROVE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT PROSPECTS
occupation: Founder and Co-CEO, and AI Domain Expert Contractor

session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: Although I only completed 2 of the 5 original steps, Claude created a hearty analysis of the complex questions I posed regarding HRIS applications and BD opportunities.

Step 1.step_name: Brainstorming — HRIS apps for business development
Step 1.step_action: Explain the business owner's situation to Claude: what free or low-cost (under $5/month) HRIS applications would you recommend a new business owner learn to improve their business development prospects in terms of contracts or partnerships earned?

nodes.label: Request affordable HRIS recommendations for business development
Research and recommend free or low-cost HRIS platforms
Review the response about free or low-cost HRIS platforms and check the folders
Restart the HRIS inquiry after encountering an upload limit
nodes.detail: The participant attaches six HRIS research PDFs, encounters Claude's upload limit, and opens a new tab to repeat the HRIS recommendation request, including the free or low-cost requirement.

nodes.label: Review uploaded research and recommend low-cost HRIS platforms
nodes.detail: Claude retries failed document reads, processes the six uploaded PDFs, and recommends Zoho People, TalentHR, and HR.my. It also discusses Rippling's partner program as a potential business development opportunity.

nodes.label: Review HRIS recommendations and conduct independent research
nodes.detail: The participant reviews Claude's HRIS recommendations and pricing rationale, then conducts independent research on Reddit to assess real-world user experiences.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning: 1a is where the user first describes the task: free or low-cost HRIS apps (under $5/month) a new business owner should learn for business development. The user repeats the request with six research PDFs attached in 1d after hitting an upload limit, which is a retry of the same task in the same tool, not a new one. Claude's output in 1e recommends Zoho People, TalentHR and HR.my, with Rippling's partner program for business development. In 1f the user takes Claude's recommended platforms, including Zoho People, and researches them on Reddit to check real-world user experiences. Using the recommended list as the input to the next step, unchanged, makes this an adopt.

Step 2.step_name: Brainstorming — the most commonly used HRIS apps today
Step 2.step_action: Segue into the most common HRIS apps used today: list and provide URLs to the most commonly used HRIS applications a job seeker needs to stay competitive, analyzing job posting data on common job-seeking platforms to determine what employers are seeking.

nodes.label: Request an analysis of commonly used HRIS platforms and employer requirements
nodes.detail: The participant uploads three HRIS research PDFs and asks Claude to identify commonly used HRIS applications, provide their URLs, and analyze job postings to determine which platforms employers seek in candidates.

nodes.label: Analyze HRIS job market demand and recommend platforms for career competitiveness
nodes.detail: Claude retries failed document reads, extracts information from the three uploaded PDFs, and searches for job-posting and market data to cross-check the documents. It compares HRIS and ATS platforms by employer demand and recommends platforms for the participant to learn.

nodes.label: Review HRIS job market analysis and platform recommendations
nodes.detail: The participant reviews Claude's analysis of employer demand, recommended HRIS platforms, and supporting evidence.

nodes.label: Commissioning a takeaway document
nodes.detail: Asks for the list of HRIS applications packaged as a PDF

nodes.label: Build the combined reference PDF
nodes.detail: Three pages covering both lists plus a sources page. It's not clear from the user's prompt whether they asked for both lists or just the second list, but Claude interpreted it as the former.

nodes.label: Compare HRIS platforms by usability and customer support
nodes.detail: Claude gathers independent usability and support information, compares the recommended HRIS platforms in terms of usefulness, beginner-friendliness, and customer support, and flags insufficient Paycom-specific evidence due to search results conflating Paycom with Paycor.

nodes.label: Review HRIS comparisons and attempt to access the reference PDF
nodes.detail: The participant reviews Claude's comparative analysis of HRIS usability and customer support, revisits the generated reference PDF, and encounters a 'File access was denied' error when attempting to open it.

Step 1.step_name: Brainstorming — HRIS apps for business development
Step 1.step_action: Explain the business owner's situation to Claude: what free or low-cost (under $5/month) HRIS applications would you recommend a new business owner learn to improve their business development prospects in terms of contracts or partnerships earned?
Step 1.input: Explain the business owner’s situation to the Claude AI by stating the following (or something similar): “What Human Resources Information (HRIS) applications would you recommend a new business owner learns to improve their business development (BD) prospects in terms of contracts or partnerships earned? Please focus on HRIS apps that are free or low-cost (under $5 per month). The apps must be able to be used on a Desktop or Laptop PC. The business owner does have a least 5 years of expertise in the HR field as an HR Generalist, HR Manager, or HR Specialist.”
Step 1.output: Search results I converted into PDF format; the file names are as follows:11 Best HRIS Systems for Small Businesses _ Paychex, 16 best HRIS systems for small businesses _ HiBob, Grow Faster with Rippling’s Partner Ecosystem _ Rippling, HR Software Pricing & Editions _ Start your 30-day free trial _ Zoho People, Top 5 Free HR Software for Small Businesses in 2024, Top HRIS Software for Small Businesses_ Features, Pros & Cons _ CO- by US Chamber of Commerce
Step 1.tools: Claude, Google AI mode, Google searches, Adobe Acrobat, Microsoft Word

ratings.output_quality_reason: I particularly felt that Claude’s recommendation of Rippling as a possible BD source was noteworthy, as I just learned something new today that may be beneficial for HR practitioners and small business leaders/owners. Further, I liked the clean, intuitive format Claude provided. The output PDF document looks very professional.

goal_achievement.Why or why not: Claude answered the questions I posed in an extremely comprehensive manner in accordance with my $5 per month spending limit for HRIS applications.

Step 2.step_name: Brainstorming — the most commonly used HRIS apps today
Step 2.step_action: Segue into the most common HRIS apps used today: list and provide URLs to the most commonly used HRIS applications a job seeker needs to stay competitive, analyzing job posting data on common job-seeking platforms to determine what employers are seeking.
Step 2.input: Segue into the most common HRIS apps used today: “For optimal benefit for BD purposes, please list and provide URLs to the most commonly used HRIS applications a job seeker (e.g., full-time, part-time, contractor/freelance) needs to stay competitive to secure meaningful work or work projects. For instance, analyze job posting data on the common job-seeking platforms (Indeed.com, CareerBuilder.com, corporate websites) and determine the most commonly used applications employers are seeking from job candidates.”
Step 2.output: Search results I converted into PDF format; the file names are as follows:Top 30 HR Tools of 2026 Compared & Reviewed _ Best Tools, Workable vs Workday - The Ultimate 2026 ATS & HCM Comparison Guide, The 10 Best HRIS Software for HR Managers [2026] _ Paylocity
Step 2.tools: Claude, Google AI mode, Google searches, Adobe Acrobat, Microsoft Word

ratings.output_quality_reason: Claude’s findings and analysis are congruent with my general experience as both an HR practitioner and as a job seeker.

goal_achievement.Why or why not: Claude located the most commonly used and some of the most effective talent acquisition platforms in the industry.
